# appsignal_dashboard (Resource)

A dashboard in an AppSignal app. Add graphs with appsignal_dashboard_timeseries and appsignal_dashboard_number; destroying the dashboard also deletes its visuals.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_dashboard" "workers" {
  app_id      = appsignal_app.web.id
  title       = "Workers"
  description = "Queue depth and job throughput"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_dashboard.workers <app_id>/<dashboard_id>
```
